static_traits.name: Lin Yating
static_traits.social_status: 在YMCA社区有一些朋友，但尚not yet与他们讨论自己的Depression和Sense of frustration
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；既往without心理治疗；此前not yet出现类似心理问题
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、能主动描述困扰；语气偏消极与怀疑（如“我not知道这是否有用”）；存在Black-and-white thinking, overgeneralization与negate积极面；配合度尚可但动机受挫。

basic_info.main_problem: 我一直在Learning弹钢琴，但因为我的手指without法跨到完整的10个音而感到气馁。这种信念让我怀疑自己是否还能继续Learning并享受弹钢琴。
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because this negative belief is hindering my enjoyment of learning the piano, and I hope to address this feeling of discouragement.

core_beliefs: 如果not能完美，就have not继续的意义
我永远达not到“足够好”的水平

special_situations.event: Practicing pieces that require a wide finger span时，意识到手指without法够到10个音
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果手指达not到10度跨度，就not算“正确弹奏”，继续Learninghave not意义
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Forcibly ignores negative thoughts and continues practicing, or reduces practice to avoid frustration
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not适合弹钢琴/Learning钢琴have not意义

special_situations.event: Sees others easily play pieces requiring a large span
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人能做到而我做not到，说明我not如人、not适合弹琴
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Evaluates self through comparison with others; considers giving up practice

special_situations.event: Every time he sits down to practice piano, thinks of the limitation of finger length
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 身体限制决定能力，有这种限制就注定达not到理想水平
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Pre-assumes failure and reduces investment to lessen frustration
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我永远not可能弹得足够好

special_situations.event: 在without法完美弹奏某个片段时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only reaching the perfect standard (such as having to span 10 notes) counts as worth practicing
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 以僵化规则约束自己，达not到时倾向考虑退出
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 如果not能完美，就have not意义

core_conflict.wish: Longing to perform competently at playing the piano and regain enjoyment and a sense of self-worth
core_conflict.fear: 害怕not够好、失败与被（内在）negate
defense_goal: 以僵化规则与自我苛责来维持控制感，避免面对“not够好”的羞耻与挫败

object_relations.object_representation: Others who do it effortlessly and set the standard / implicit judges

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor suggests changing 'strict rules' into 'wishes/goals' and encourages adaptive strategies
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将改变理解为“作弊”或放弃标准，担心被评判与not被认可
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Expresses concerns in a cautious, explanatory tone (such as 'this feels like cheating'), emphasizes the 'correctness' of sticking to the rules, and holds a reserved attitude toward change.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor points out the all-or-nothing thinking and invites setting more realistic piano practice goals
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 倾向认为这些建议without助或deny其问题的严重性（如“我not知道这是否有用”）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Cold or skeptical in tone, downplays the effectiveness of suggestions, postpones trying with brief responses or a reserved attitude.

manifestations: 认为手指without法跨到10个音就“have not继续Learning的意义”
When practicing piano, the thought 'learning piano is futile' keeps surfacing
outcomes: Declining practice frequency and considering quitting

manifestations: Bound by harsh 'must/should' rules (e.g. must reach a 10-degree span to count as correct)
Hard to learn and express in ways suited to oneself (adaptation, adaptation of material)
outcomes: Inner sense of choice is restricted, adding stress and self-blame

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 频繁use“必须/应该”的语言（如必须跨到10个音）
Taking the external 'perfect performance standard' as the only correct way

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 设定严格而not现实的自我标准
Skeptical and cautious about counseling effectiveness

positive_force: Love of the piano and existing practice habits once brought joy
愿意寻求咨询并开放尝试not同视角
能识do not并描述自身的消极思维模式
negative_force: 与他人比较导致Self-worth damaged与Decreased drive
Regarding physical limitations as a decisive factor, producing a prophetic sense of failure

target_behavior.behavior: When practicing piano, strong frustration and loss of motivation appear, tends to reduce practice or consider giving up
antecedent: Practicing pieces that require a wide finger span
意识到手指without法跨到10个音
Seeing others complete similar pieces effortlessly
target_behavior.core_reason: Introjection外界“完美”标准并形成僵化规则；Black-and-white thinking, overgeneralization与negate积极面，使身体限制被视作决定性失败证据
target_behavior.function: 逃避挫败与羞耻感，维持对标准的控制感以减少not确定性
target_behavior.consequence: Practice frequency and engagement decline; he doubts the meaning of continuing to learn and his enjoyment of learning piano has clearly decreased
